name: OneGate Vault
description: Random-GAS rewards with two roles. Recipients claim a 1-50 GAS random reward by scanning a OneGate QR with an embedded single-use key (paid by the campaign's reward server). Campaign owners create, fund, top up, and recover random-GAS reward pools and share the QR claim links.
description_zh: 随机 GAS 奖励，含两种角色。领取人通过 OneGate 扫码（带一次性 key）领取 1-50 GAS 随机奖励（由活动的奖励服务器发放）。活动发起者创建、注资、补充并取回随机 GAS 奖励池，并分享扫码领取链接。
description_ja: 2つの役割を持つランダムGAS報酬。受取人は一回限りのkeyが埋め込まれたOneGate QRをスキャンして1〜50 GASのランダム報酬を受け取ります（キャンペーンの報酬サーバーが支払い）。キャンペーン管理者はランダムGAS報酬プールを作成・資金提供・追加・回収し、QR受取リンクを共有します。

operation_panel.title: OneGate Vault
operation_panel.subtitle: Claim the reward loaded from a OneGate QR scan.

operations.name: Claim Reward
operations.description: The OneGate QR supplies the one-time reward key automatically. Claim sends GAS to the connected OneGate wallet.

aa.description: Claims use a OneGate wallet address and a server-backed GAS payout rather than AA execution.

tee.description: The 1-50 GAS reward bounds and one-use keys are enforced by the backend claim engine.

neodid.description: NeoDID gating is not required for the initial reward-pool release.
